nodes.label: sjsu_cs_2026_2027.sql (normalized 2026-27 catalog dataset)
nodes.rationale: Idempotent (CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS, ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING); fills separate normalized tables that the application does not read directly.

nodes.label: sjsu-catalog-2026-27-sync.sql (catalog-to-course sync)
nodes.rationale: One rerunnable transaction: inserts 59 missing catalog courses (85 total; unknown units stored as 0), updates titles/units and official descriptions for 13 CS courses, adds and sets category, and rebuilds prerequisites for the 13 CS courses with catalog rules (CS 146 gains CS 48); prerequisite_notes and sources are not modified.

nodes.label: sjsu-course-prerequisite-codes.sql (prerequisite code arrays import)
nodes.rationale: 21 courses get extracted codes (including alternatives and conditional prerequisites, excluding concurrent workshops and recommendations); 5 have none. Empty arrays do not imply unrestricted enrollment.

nodes.label: sjsu-course-prerequisite-notes.sql (prerequisite notes and source metadata import)
nodes.norm_label: sjsu-course-prerequisite-notes.sql (prerequisite notes and source metadata import)

nodes.label: sjsu-cs-2026-2027.sql (roadmap course import)
nodes.rationale: Adds 26 roadmap courses; preserves existing codes and is rerunnable without duplicates; runs in one transaction and locks the course table. Descriptions record roadmap placement, not official course descriptions.

nodes.label: Course requests section (course fields incl. category)
nodes.norm_label: course requests section (course fields incl. category)
nodes.rationale: The prerequisite filter matches references including alternatives and conditional prerequisites, so it does not establish eligibility; the code-array endpoint returns referenced codes even without full course records.

nodes.label: CoursePlannerService (legacy, removed)
nodes.rationale: Removed together with its containsAll helper and the unused Student and Schedule models; eligibility is now evaluated only by EligibilityService.

nodes.label: Eligibility check requests (POST /api/eligibility/check)
nodes.rationale: Evaluates prerequisite readiness only, not availability or degree applicability; completed prerequisites need no database records; an unknown target course returns 404 for the whole request; grades and consent are self-reported.

nodes.label: Eligibility statuses (eligible / ineligible / needs_review)
nodes.rationale: Failure of one alternative branch is not enough for ineligible if another branch passes or needs review; missing information, provisional sources, or unimplemented rules yield needs_review.

nodes.label: Saved plan requests (create/get/replace/delete)
nodes.rationale: PUT replaces the entire selection; rejected updates preserve the existing plan; duplicates and over-limit totals return 400; plans are drafts that do not assert eligibility or timetable conflicts; no accounts or ownership.

nodes.label: Completed-class tracking (transitive prerequisite coverage)
nodes.rationale: Marking a class counts its prerequisites as completed transitively; because prerequisite lists include alternatives, every listed alternative is covered, not only the one taken. Selection is saved per browser in localStorage (no accounts).

nodes.label: Import course data section (ordered manual psql imports)
nodes.norm_label: import course data section (ordered manual psql imports)
nodes.rationale: Five imports run in order after the app has created tables: the first three load 26 roadmap courses with researched notes, the last two load and sync the normalized 2026-27 catalog, bringing the course table to 85 courses. Still not a complete university catalog.

nodes.label: Off-catalog prerequisites (e.g. MATH 19, CMPE 102)
nodes.rationale: Accepted as completed codes because students may have completed courses that were not imported; off-catalog variants (ENGL 1AF, MATH 31X) follow the catalog course they extend.

nodes.label: Most-referenced prerequisites ranking panel
nodes.rationale: Score remaining/total shows how many not-yet-completed courses still list a class; grouped into Major/GE/Elective sections then by subject. A high rank means most referenced, not required, because lists include alternatives.

nodes.label: SPRING_DATASOURCE_* environment variables
nodes.rationale: Override application.properties so real local credentials are never committed; the same variables point backend tests at a separate test database.

nodes.label: Tests section (Vitest frontend, PostgreSQL-backed backend tests)
nodes.norm_label: tests section (vitest frontend, postgresql-backed backend tests)
nodes.rationale: Frontend tests need no backend; backend tests need a reachable PostgreSQL and create their own fixtures; API tests roll back data but not schema creation or identity-sequence advancement.

nodes.label: course.category column (Major / GE / Elective)
nodes.rationale: GE when the roadmap description carries a GE Area tag (8 courses), Elective when the course appears only in elective requirement groups (43), otherwise Major (34); MATH 142 and MATH 161A stay Major because they also satisfy the required additional-math choice.

nodes.label: Excluded CS elective codes (no titles/units, not imported)
nodes.norm_label: excluded cs elective codes (no titles/units, not imported)

nodes.label: Normalized catalog tables (universities, catalog_editions, programs, courses, requirement_groups, prerequisite_rules, source_evidence)
nodes.norm_label: normalized catalog tables (universities, catalog_editions, programs, courses, requirement_groups, prerequisite_rules, source_evidence)

nodes.label: Course Planner (project overview)
nodes.rationale: Spring Boot REST backend plus React frontend for exploring SJSU CS courses, tracking completed classes, ranking most-referenced prerequisites, checking prerequisite readiness, and saving semester plans in PostgreSQL.

nodes.label: Program Roadmap: Computer Science, BS (SJSU 2026-2027 Academic Catalog PDF)
nodes.norm_label: program roadmap: computer science, bs (sjsu 2026-2027 academic catalog pdf)

nodes.label: SJSU Computer Science roadmap import guide
nodes.norm_label: sjsu computer science roadmap import guide

nodes.label: Supported eligibility rules (10 curated courses)
nodes.rationale: Rules for CS 47, 146, 147, 149, 151, 152, 154, 157A, 160, 166 are curated in EligibilityService rather than parsed from flat prerequisite arrays, and apply only with SJSU_SYLLABUS source metadata; the remaining 16 imported courses return needs_review.

nodes.label: Hibernate ddl-auto=update schema creation
nodes.rationale: Tables are created/updated on application startup, so the app must start once before the manual SQL imports; imports are never run automatically at startup.

nodes.label: Limitations (no auth, draft plans, partial eligibility rules)
nodes.norm_label: limitations (no auth, draft plans, partial eligibility rules)
nodes.rationale: Explicit eligibility rules cover only 10 courses; saved plans are drafts that check unit limits but not eligibility or timetable conflicts; no authentication or plan ownership, so keep the instance local; completed classes are per browser; plans and eligibility are API-only (createPlan has no UI yet).

nodes.label: Prerequisite arrays as references, not an all-required checklist
nodes.norm_label: prerequisite arrays as references, not an all-required checklist
nodes.rationale: Arrays include alternatives and conditional prerequisites, so they cannot be treated as a required set; readiness is evaluated by curated rules, and the notes and report hold the full rules.

nodes.label: Prerequisite research sources (SJSU syllabi for 19 courses, provisional secondary sources for 7)
nodes.norm_label: prerequisite research sources (sjsu syllabi for 19 courses, provisional secondary sources for 7)
nodes.rationale: The official catalog blocked automated access, so the research used SJSU syllabi and department pages, plus explicitly provisional secondary sources for seven courses.

nodes.label: Course code normalization (trim, collapse whitespace, uppercase)
nodes.norm_label: course code normalization (trim, collapse whitespace, uppercase)
nodes.rationale: The space between subject and number is significant (CS146 is a different code from CS 146); sorting is by stored string, not numeric course number.

nodes.label: Prerequisite frequency endpoint (count, remainingCount, requiredBy)
nodes.rationale: Entries sorted by remainingCount desc, count desc, code asc; completed is repeatable and commas do not separate values; count measures mentions, not requirements, so readiness should use the eligibility endpoint.

nodes.label: Vite /api development proxy
nodes.rationale: Forwards /api to localhost:8080 so the frontend uses relative URLs without backend CORS changes; the proxy is not part of the production build, so production hosting must route /api to Spring Boot.
